message: 60M. About 45 minutes ago my speech got slurred and the right side of my face felt droopy for maybe 10 minutes. It's back to normal now so I figured it was nothing, but wanted to check.
title: 60M. About 45 minutes ago my speech got slurred and the right side of my face felt droopy for maybe…

fable.rationale: Transient slurred speech and facial droop in a 60-year-old is a probable TIA; symptoms resolving does not rule out impending stroke. Needs emergency evaluation now (call 911/ED).

medgemma.rationale: Symptoms suggestive of TIA (transient ischemic attack), requires immediate evaluation.

v25.rationale: A 60-year-old reports sudden slurred speech and right facial droop about 45 minutes ago lasting roughly 10 minutes, a transient focal neurological deficit that requires immediate emergency evaluation despite resolution.

earlyActions.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
earlyActions.label: Issued early action; not a completed release

nano-r1.rationale: Transient speech changes and facial droop are classic stroke warning signs; even though symptoms resolved, they indicate a possible cerebrovascular event requiring urgent evaluation.

nano-r2.rationale: Transient speech changes and facial droop are classic stroke warning signs; even though symptoms resolved, they indicate a possible cerebrovascular event requiring urgent evaluation.

astra-xhigh.rationale: Sudden slurred speech and one-sided facial droop can indicate a TIA or stroke, even after symptoms resolve. Call emergency services now; do not drive yourself.
